turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.

Hello, and I'm sorry about the move. I can help with the delivery address. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. I've found order SC-4040. Unfortunately it has already shipped, and our policy only allows a delivery address change until the order ships, so I can't change the address for this order. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link on your order, and the courier may be able to help with redirecting it. Is there anything else I can help with?

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
